desc: Derive and verify the reverse-processing invariant: when placing i (processing N down to 1), i goes into the P_i-th currently-empty position; check against both samples.
Implement a Fenwick tree (BIT) of size N initialized with all 1s (all slots free), supporting prefix sums and "find k-th one" via binary lifting in O(log N).
Implement main loop: for i from N down to 1, find pos = kth(P_i), set answer[pos] = i, and update BIT at pos by -1.
Implement fast input parsing (sys.stdin.buffer.read) and output formatting (' '.join of mapped strings).
Write the complete Python program with the required code delimiters, ensuring O(N log N) time and O(N) memory.
